company.name: Smyte
company.shortDescription: Smyte stops bad actors on marketplaces and social networks.
company.description: Smyte protects millions of actions a day and was built by industry experts to scale to even the most complex trust and safety use cases. Smyte code into any website or mobile app, which gives Smyte access to a data feed. Smyte’s automated labeling system identifies any potentially malicious activity, based on a variety of signals and relationships, and flags it for manual review.
